subject: Post-demo sizing: unit price targets & dedicated GPU bands
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@healthlytics.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up after demo

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo earlier — it gave the team a good sense of Redwood's dedicated lanes and latency profile. A couple quick follow-ups from our side as we start sizing:

- Rough monthly token volumes (est): ~120M–180M tokens/month across inference + reranking.
- Peak concurrency: expect spikes up to ~180 concurrent requests during batch scoring windows.
- Latency target: 95th pct < 250ms for single-turn generation (our UI is latency-sensitive).
- Budget range we have in mind for inference: roughly $18k–$30k/month initially (we can adjust with clear unit economics).

We also wanted a sense of how reserved capacity maps to unit price — what would a 2x H100 vs 4x A100 reserved pool look like in $/1M tokens, ballpark?

I'll loop in our procurement lead if we get close on numbers.

Best,
Olivia
VP Product, HealthLytics

--

Hi Olivia — great to hear, thanks for the clear numbers. Quick recap + what we need to finalize a proposal: 

Recap of what you shared:
- Monthly tokens: 120M–180M
- Peak concurrency: ~180 qps spikes, sustained ~40 qps
- Latency SLO: 95p < 250ms
- Budget target: $18k–$30k/month

What we'll provide next (by Tue):
1) Two Dedicated pricing bands (2x H100 reserved vs 4x A100 reserved) with unit $/1M token guidance and expected sustained throughput, plus a pilot 3-month commit option to validate latency & cost.
2) Token-to-GPU mapping assumptions (tokens/sec per GPU at your target seq lengths) and suggested autoscale/burst policy to handle spikes while keeping unit economics intact.
3) A sample mutual action plan with timelines for pilot, procurement sign-off, and rollout.

Couple quick clarifying Qs that will materially affect the unit price:
- Average prompt + generation length (tokens per request) and ratio of embedding/rerank calls vs gen calls?
- Any hard requirement for on-prem/VPC (or is Hosted/Dedicated OK)?

Marissa — can you prep a short dedicated-quote spreadsheet with two bands and a pilot option? Ben — can you capture the SKU mapping we typically use for a 150M token/month workload (assumptions we can show the customer)?

Olivia — if you can send a short token sample (anonymized) or distribution, that will help tighten the unit price. I'll attach a short demo-notes PDF for internal reference.

Thanks — talk soon.

Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-05-17T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after demo

Thanks Karthik — answered inline below and adding a couple more specifics: 

> Average prompt + generation length (tokens per request)
Our average end-to-end request is ~220 tokens (prompt ~70, gen ~150). For batch scoring jobs the length varies, but the distribution skews shorter (50–120 tokens).

> Ratio of embedding/rerank vs gen calls
Approximately 60% generation, 30% rerank (shorter tokens), 10% embeddings.

Additional notes:
- We're comfortable with Hosted for the pilot but will need Dedicated (VPC) for production because of PHI concerns.
- Procurement asked for a target unit rate at or below $22 / 1M tokens to fit the initial budget. If you can show split pricing for pilot (higher) vs reserved (lower) that would help.

We'll plan to share a small sample of anonymized request logs by Friday. If you can get a draft quote to us by Tuesday that includes a 90‑day pilot and a 12‑month reserved option, that would be ideal.

Olivia

Thanks Olivia — this is very helpful. Next steps and our draft economics below.

Proposed next steps:
- Karthik/Marissa: deliver a draft Dedicated quote by EOD Tue (5/18) with 90-day pilot + 12-month reserved banding.
- HealthLytics: send anonymized request-log sample by Fri (5/21).
- Schedule pricing walkthrough w/ procurement and finance (Marissa suggested Wed 5/19 at 10am PT) — confirm if that works.

Draft economics (ballpark, subject to final logs):
- Pilot (90d, hosted/dedicated hybrid): $36k total pilot fee (includes burst capacity), implied unit ~ $48 / 1M tokens (pilot amortized for validation).
- Reserved band A (2x H100 80GB reserved): target unit $/1M tokens = $21–$23, expected sustained throughput ~45–60 qps, handles sustained workload; burst policy recommended to absorb spikes to 180 qps.
- Reserved band B (4x A100 80GB reserved): target unit $/1M tokens = $18–$20, expected sustained throughput ~85–110 qps, better for steady heavy throughput but higher commitment.

Assumptions: 150M tokens/month mid-case, average 220 tokens/request, quantization to INT8-compatible model variant, 95p latency at your 250ms SLO with continuous batching and KV cache for prefix reuse.

Attachments: proposed-dedicated-quote.xlsx (contains SKU, per-month commit, and rollout milestones). We'll include a clear cost-per-1M tokens table plus token-to-gpu mapping.

If those bands look acceptable, we'll convert the preferred band into a formal PO path with legal and procurement and load a pilot SLA. If not, we can iterate — happy to run sensitivity scenarios (e.g., 100M vs 200M tokens).

Best,
